_PROVENANCE.purpose: Honest diagnosis + improvement of pH from optics on REAL Sentinel-2 x USGS data. Decomposes pH signal into optics-only vs covariate-only (Temp+SpCond) vs combined. Bar = shipped HydroViT ViT pH R2 0.3109 (same bands, station holdout).
_PROVENANCE.data: data/processed/satellite/drone_wq_pairs.npz (REAL Sentinel-2 L2A B02,B03,B04,B08 paired with REAL same-day USGS/NWIS in-situ WQ).
_PROVENANCE.split: STATION (site_id) GroupKFold — no site shared train/test; pooled out-of-fold predictions.
_PROVENANCE.ci: site-clustered bootstrap (resamples SITES, not rows), 2000 reps; paired delta CI vs matched-set optics; scalar delta CI vs shipped bar.
_PROVENANCE.model: HistGradientBoosting regressor (CPU), same family as the red-edge chl-a study that beat the ViT.
_PROVENANCE.covariate_note: Temp & SpCond features = REAL in-situ same-day covariates. SpCond (ionic strength/alkalinity) is chemically tied to pH but is NOT optical; any pH gain from Temp/SpCond is labeled covariate-driven, NOT an optical claim.

shipped_baseline.note: ViT-S/16 on same 4 bands + station holdout; the pure-optics comparator.

A_optics_only.features: 4-band spatial stats + CDOM/chl/turbidity proxy indices (no covar)

B_covar_only.features: in-situ Temp + SpCond only (2 features, non-optical chemistry)

A_optics_only_matched_set.note: optics-only evaluated on the SAME rows as B/C for fair paired deltas

optics_vs_hydrovit_shipped.interpretation: pure-optics GBM vs pure-optics ViT, same bands & station holdout. IMPROVED iff delta CI lower bound > 0.

covar_marginal_C_minus_Aoptics.interpretation: R2 gain from ADDING Temp+SpCond to optics (paired). This gain is COVARIATE-driven chemistry, NOT new optical signal.

optics_marginal_C_minus_covar.interpretation: R2 gain from ADDING optics on top of Temp+SpCond (paired). Isolates GENUINE optical pH information beyond chemistry.

combined_vs_hydrovit_shipped.interpretation: optics+Temp+SpCond vs shipped ViT. NOT a pure-optics claim; any lift over optics-only is covariate-driven chemistry.

verdict.optics_vs_hydrovit: NOT IMPROVED (pure optics): optics-only R2=0.287 <= 0.311. pH is weakly optical; this GBM does not beat the ViT on optics alone.
verdict.optics_beyond_covar: Optics adds REAL signal beyond Temp+SpCond: C-B delta=+0.141 CI[+0.101,+0.184] excludes 0.
verdict.covariate_share: Covar-only R2=0.367 vs optics-only R2=0.264 vs combined R2=0.508. Adding Temp+SpCond to optics lifts R2 by +0.246 (CI[+0.199,+0.297]). Any combined 'improvement' over optics is COVARIATE chemistry, not optical.
verdict.weak_optical_limit: pH has no intrinsic color; optical recovery is capped by CDOM/chl/turbidity proxies. Optics-only R2=0.287 quantifies that weak-optical ceiling.

improved_definition: PURE-OPTICS claim: optics-only (new_r2 - shipped ViT 0.3109) site-bootstrap delta CI lower bound > 0, on a station GroupKFold holdout. The optics+covar arm is reported but flagged covariate-driven, not an optical claim.
